entities.name: Fosphenytoin
observations: Exact queried SMILES resolves to fosphenytoin, PubChem CID 56339, CAS 93390-81-9, InChIKey XWLUWCNOOVRFPX-UHFFFAOYSA-N.
Used for generalized tonic-clonic status epilepticus, perioperative seizure prevention/treatment, and temporary substitution for oral phenytoin.
The retrieved evidence did not provide a ClinTox or clinical-trial toxicity classification.
